name: HYDRA-UMC-EDITOR-URDF
build: Desktop PySide6/Qt6 app. run.bat/run.sh runs it from source; build-test.bat/build-test.sh validates sources without versioning; build_exe.bat/build_exe.sh produces a standalone PyInstaller executable.
notes: Desktop graphical URDF creator/editor with real, shipped features (GitHub/local source loading, mesh reference resolution, DOF feasibility validation, live 3D preview editing) - pushes finished models to HYDRA-UMC-STUDIO's own model catalog via HYDRA-UMC-SERVER's POST /api/models/submit. tests/ now covers 177 real cases across the app's own pure logic (URDF parse/write, DOF validation, kinematics, inertia estimation, mesh resolution, GitHub fetching, i18n) via pytest, none of which need PySide6 - wired into CI, closing a real zero-test-coverage gap found while auditing the code.
